tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything: main content area of list and board views.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar, detail side panel. One step off the canvas, separated by border-subtle, never by shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: inputs, cards, menus, command palette, modals.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items and ghost buttons. Also the fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-4
tokens.usage: Pressed / active fill; hover on secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and between shell regions (sidebar edge, top-bar bottom). 1px only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default control and card borders: inputs, menus, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered control borders, checkbox outlines, dividers that must read at a glance. 3:1 against surface-0 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, issue titles, input values, primary labels. Legible on every surface token in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Body copy in panels, nav labels, secondary metadata. 4.5:1+ on surface-0 to surface-3 in both themes.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Issue IDs, timestamps, placeholders, section labels. Passes 4.5:1 on surface-0/1/2; on surface-3 use only at 12px+ and never for the only copy of key information.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control labels only. Exempt from contrast rules; always pair with a non-color disabled cue (no hover, cursor not-allowed).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Primary button fill, selected checkbox, progress. on-accent text sits on it at 4.5:1+. At most one accent-filled control per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active nav label, accent icons on surfaces. Never use the accent fill colour for small text.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row / active nav item background, accent badge background. Text on it: text-primary or accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element. 3:1+ on all surfaces.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done / completed status icon and text.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In review, at-risk, due soon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Urgent priority, overdue, destructive actions, errors.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners, destructive menu item hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In progress status, informational notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and banners.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind modals and the command palette.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headers and empty-state heroes only. Never inside the app shell.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles, issue title in the detail view.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Section headers in settings, modal titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Long-form text: issue descriptions, comments, docs.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: THE default app text: list rows, buttons, nav items, inputs, menus.

styles.name: ui-regular
styles.usage: Secondary text inside rows and menus where weight 500 is too loud.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Badges, timestamps, issue IDs, helper text.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels and table headers. Sentence case, not all caps.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code, branch names, keyboard shortcut glyphs.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Every padding, gap and margin is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges, kbd inner padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside badges; gap between stacked kbd keys.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons, rows and nav items; horizontal padding of small controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, inputs, rows and nav items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between form fields, menu padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Content gutter inside the detail panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side padding, modal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding, top of settings pages.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd keys, checkboxes, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows on hover, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers, board cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status dots, toggles.

shadow.note: Shadows only for things that float above the page. Panels and cards use borders.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, raised toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the command palette.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, inline filters, toolbar icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary form actions, command palette input row.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: List row height. Rows never wrap; titles truncate.

tokens.name: icon-size
tokens.usage: Every UI icon. 14px only inside badges.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: View header with title, filters and display options.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width; resizable 200 to 320px.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand detail / properties panel.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky group headers in lists.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and command palette with their backdrop.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts.
